nvitk.segmentation.mask_ops
===========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.segmentation.mask_ops

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Binary mask logical operators and mask→image intensity apply.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: mask_union(mask_a: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask_b: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Voxels where either mask is foreground (OR).


.. py:function:: mask_intersection(mask_a: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask_b: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Voxels where both masks are foreground (AND).


.. py:function:: mask_subtract(mask_a: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask_b: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, keep_overlap: bool = False) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Foreground in *mask_a* not in *mask_b* (A \ B), or overlap only if *keep_overlap*.


.. py:function:: mask_xor(mask_a: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask_b: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Symmetric difference (A ⊕ B).


.. py:function:: mask_complement(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, within: nvitk.types.Image | Any | None = None) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Logical NOT of *mask*; optional *within* ROI limits the complement region.


.. py:function:: apply_mask_to_image(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, mode: str = 'keep_inside', fill_value: float = 0.0, label_ids: collections.abc.Sequence[int] | None = None) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Apply a segmentation mask to an intensity image.

   :param image: Intensity volume (active layer).
   :param mask: Segmentation / binary mask on the same grid as *image*.
   :param mode: ``keep_inside`` — retain voxels where the mask is foreground; fill the rest.
                ``keep_outside`` — retain voxels where the mask is background; fill the rest.
   :param fill_value: Value written into discarded voxels (default ``0``).
   :param label_ids: Optional label ids treated as foreground; ``None`` / empty → any nonzero.
